territorial_scope.description: Obligations attach to personal-data databases and their controllers and holders in Israel; the text defines the database-location link in Israeli terms and does not state reach beyond it.

evidence.quote: ובלבד שהוא מידע אישי במאגר מידע הנמצא בישראל

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Protection of Privacy Law 5741-1981 as amended in 2024 (Amendment 13). Regulates privacy infringements and personal-data databases in Israel: registration, security, direct-marketing and access duties for controllers and holders; Privacy Protection Authority inspection, administrative fines, cease orders and criminal and civil liability.
summary.long: The Act makes privacy infringements civil wrongs and some of them criminal offences (ss. 2, 4, 5). Chapter B governs personal-data databases: purpose limitation and lawful processing (s. 8); registration for databases above 10,000 persons or held by public bodies, with notification duties for sensitive-data databases above 100,000 persons (s. 8A); registrar powers (ss. 9-10); notice to data subjects on collection (s. 11); access and correction rights (ss. 13-14); security duties and security officers (ss. 17, 17B); mandatory privacy officers for named categories (s. 17B1) and their functions (ss. 17B2-17B3); direct-marketing rules (ss. 17D-17F). Chapter C establishes the Privacy Protection Authority. Chapters D and D1 cover public-body data disclosure and inspection powers. Chapter D3 provides cease orders, administrative fines (indexed amounts stated in s. 23K), warnings and undertakings. Chapter D4 covers criminal investigation and offences, and D5 limits enforcement during election periods. Liquidated damages without proof of harm are in s. 15A. The text does not refer to artificial intelligence. Chapter B takes effect six months after publication (s. 37).

notes: Consolidated Hebrew text with [תיקון] tags. The text does not name the amending laws, so Amendment No. 13 (2024) from registry metadata is not verified in the text. Amounts in brackets are 2026 indexed figures; section 23לב(ב) makes 2026 the first indexation year, and the header cites an amount notice 'י״פ תשפ״ז, 654' without stating its content. Section 23כ(ב)(2) is a future-dated provision (from 14.8.2028) applying Chapter 4.1 sections B and C to Israel Police, while 23כ(ב)(1) excludes security bodies in general. Schedule 3 item (1) contains an editorial correction '[צ״ל: פסקה]'. Publication notes for 2025 and 2026 regulations show the consolidation is later than the 2024 amendment; the consolidation date is not stated. Section 37 sets commencement for Chapter 2 only; commencement of other amended provisions is not stated.

thresholds.variable_text: personal information on more than 10,000 persons (database registration duty)

thresholds.conditions: Main purpose is collection of personal information for transfer to another for consideration or as a business, including direct mailing services

thresholds.measurement: Number of persons about whom sensitive information is held in the database

thresholds.conditions: Database is not a registrable database under Sec. 8א(א)(1)
